flow.caveat: Stage names below are the general drainage direction described in the planning document. The specific creek serving a given barangay has NOT been verified against OSM or against any LGU drainage plan. The app must not tell a user which named creek their street drains into until that verification exists.

stages.detail_en: Anything left outside ends up here when it rains.
stages.detail_tl: Nauuwi rito ang basurang naiiwan sa labas kapag umulan.

stages.detail_en: Where clogging starts. Sachets are the primary cause.
stages.detail_tl: Dito nagsisimula ang pagbara. Ang sachet ang pangunahing sanhi.

stages.detail_en: The creeks that carry water out of the municipality.
stages.detail_tl: Ang mga sapa ng Cainta na dumadaloy palabas ng bayan.
stages.note: Specific creek per barangay not yet verified — do not name one in the UI.

stages.detail_en: The major floodway channel out of the Metro Manila basin.
stages.detail_tl: Malaking daluyan ng tubig baha palabas ng Metro Manila.

stages.detail_en: The terminus. It does not come back.
stages.detail_tl: Dito nagtatapos. Hindi na ito babalik.

stages.detail_en: Clean, dry, and kept apart from wet waste.
stages.detail_tl: Malinis, tuyo, at hiwalay sa basang basura.

stages.detail_en: Where it becomes material again — and has value.
stages.detail_tl: Dito ito nagiging materyal muli — at may halaga.

stages.detail_en: Baled and shipped onward to processors.
stages.detail_tl: Pinagsama-sama at ipinapadala sa mga pagawaan.
stages.note: Downstream chain past the junkshop is unmapped for Cainta — survey Q15.

stages.detail_en: It did not end up in Laguna de Bay.
stages.detail_tl: Hindi ito napunta sa Laguna de Bay.

materials.prep_en: Empty it, rinse it, and crush it flat. Caps and labels can stay on for most buyers — confirm with the shop.
materials.prep_tl: Ubusin, banlawan, at ipisa. Karaniwang tinatanggap pati takip at label — itanong sa junkshop.
warnings: Legal basis not yet verified against the source document: Cainta Municipal Ordinance No. 2022-010; Republic Act No. 11898. Do not attribute this guidance to the municipality.
Indicative price range only — no verified Cainta shop observations yet.

materials.prep_en: Rinse out food or detergent residue. Shampoo bottles, pails, and basins count.
materials.prep_tl: Banlawan ang natirang laman. Kasama rito ang bote ng shampoo, timba, at planggana.
warnings: Legal basis not yet verified against the source document: Cainta Municipal Ordinance No. 2022-010; Republic Act No. 11898. Do not attribute this guidance to the municipality.
Indicative price range only — no verified Cainta shop observations yet.

materials.prep_en: No junkshop buys this. Keep it dry and out of the drain — this is the material that clogs Cainta's creeks. Check whether a nearby EPR take-back or ecobrick programme accepts it.
materials.prep_tl: Walang junkshop na bumibili nito. Panatilihing tuyo at huwag itapon sa kanal — ito ang bumabara sa mga sapa ng Cainta. Tingnan kung may EPR take-back o ecobrick program malapit sa inyo.
warnings: Legal basis not yet verified against the source document: Cainta Municipal Ordinance No. 2023-012; Republic Act No. 11898. Do not attribute this guidance to the municipality.

materials.prep_en: Rinse and flatten. The highest-value everyday item in most households.
materials.prep_tl: Banlawan at ipisa. Ito ang pinakamahal sa karaniwang basura sa bahay.
warnings: Legal basis not yet verified against the source document: Cainta Municipal Ordinance No. 2022-010. Do not attribute this guidance to the municipality.
Indicative price range only — no verified Cainta shop observations yet.

materials.prep_en: Sold by weight. Many shops set a minimum weight — worth checking before you carry it over.
materials.prep_tl: Timbang ang basehan. Marami ang may minimum na timbang — itanong muna bago dalhin.
warnings: Legal basis not yet verified against the source document: Cainta Municipal Ordinance No. 2022-010. Do not attribute this guidance to the municipality.
Indicative price range only — no verified Cainta shop observations yet.

materials.prep_en: The highest-value common scrap. Stripped wire is worth more than insulated.
materials.prep_tl: Pinakamataas ang halaga. Mas mahal ang hinubaran ng insulation.
warnings: Legal basis not yet verified against the source document: Cainta Municipal Ordinance No. 2022-010. Do not attribute this guidance to the municipality.
Indicative price range only — no verified Cainta shop observations yet.

materials.prep_en: Often refused by junkshops — heavy, low value, and a breakage risk. Refillable soft-drink and beer bottles are the exception: return those to the store for the deposit.
materials.prep_tl: Madalas tinatanggihan ng junkshop — mabigat, mababa ang halaga, at delikadong mabasag. Iba ang bote ng softdrinks at beer na may balik-bote — isauli sa tindahan.
warnings: Legal basis not yet verified against the source document: Cainta Municipal Ordinance No. 2022-010. Do not attribute this guidance to the municipality.
Indicative price range only — no verified Cainta shop observations yet.

materials.prep_en: Must be dry. Wet or greasy cardboard is refused, so keep it inside before a storm.
materials.prep_tl: Kailangang tuyo. Tinatanggihan ang basa o mamantika — itago sa loob bago umulan.
warnings: Legal basis not yet verified against the source document: Cainta Municipal Ordinance No. 2022-010; Republic Act No. 11898. Do not attribute this guidance to the municipality.
Indicative price range only — no verified Cainta shop observations yet.

materials.prep_en: Keep dry and bundled. White paper is graded separately from newsprint and pays more.
materials.prep_tl: Panatilihing tuyo at nakabigkis. Hiwalay ang grado ng puting papel — mas mataas ang bayad.
warnings: Legal basis not yet verified against the source document: Cainta Municipal Ordinance No. 2022-010. Do not attribute this guidance to the municipality.
Indicative price range only — no verified Cainta shop observations yet.

materials.prep_en: Compost it or set it out on the biodegradable collection day. RA 9003 treats this as a diverted stream, not residual — it is usually the largest share of household waste by weight.
materials.prep_tl: I-compost o ilabas sa araw ng nabubulok. Sa ilalim ng RA 9003, hindi ito residual — kadalasan ito ang pinakamabigat na bahagi ng basura sa bahay.
warnings: Legal basis not yet verified against the source document: Republic Act No. 9003; Cainta Municipal Ordinance No. 2022-010. Do not attribute this guidance to the municipality.

materials.prep_en: Catch-all for anything the classifier cannot place. Set out on residual collection day.
materials.prep_tl: Para sa hindi matukoy. Ilabas sa araw ng residual.
warnings: Legal basis not yet verified against the source document: Cainta Municipal Ordinance No. 2023-012. Do not attribute this guidance to the municipality.

overrides.prep_en: Keep it dry and separate, ideally taped at the terminals. Do not bin it and do not burn it. Ask the barangay when the next special waste collection is.
overrides.prep_tl: Itabi nang tuyo at hiwalay, mabuti kung natakpan ang dulo. Huwag ihalo sa basura at huwag sunugin. Itanong sa barangay kung kailan ang susunod na special waste collection.
overrides.reason_en: Batteries are special waste under RA 9003 and must not enter household residual.
overrides.reason_tl: Espesyal na basura ang baterya sa ilalim ng RA 9003 — hindi ito dapat ihalo sa residual.

overrides.prep_en: Keep it whole — do not strip it for the copper, which is where the hazard is. Look for an accredited e-waste handler or a barangay collection drive.
overrides.prep_tl: Huwag hatiin o kunan ng tanso — doon ang panganib. Hanapin ang akreditadong e-waste handler o ang collection drive ng barangay.
overrides.reason_en: Electronics need a WEEE-accredited handler. Some junkshops buy them for the copper — that is not safe handling.
overrides.reason_tl: Kailangan ng akreditadong tagakuha ang electronics. May junkshop na bumibili para sa tanso — hindi iyon ligtas na pagtatapon.

overrides.prep_en: If you can still rinse and dry it, it goes back to its normal route and keeps its value. If the soiling cannot be removed, it is residual — separating it protects the rest of the bale.
overrides.prep_tl: Kung kaya pang banlawan at patuyuin, bumalik ito sa dating ruta at may halaga pa rin. Kung hindi na maaalis ang dumi, residual na ito — ang paghihiwalay dito ang nagliligtas sa iba pang naipon.
overrides.reason_en: Food-contaminated paper and cardboard are refused at the counter and downgrade a whole bale.
overrides.reason_tl: Tinatanggihan ang papel at kartong may dumi ng pagkain — nasisira nito ang buong bale.

residual_to_slf.label_en: Residual — collected for the sanitary landfill
residual_to_slf.label_tl: Residual — kokolektahin para sa sanitary landfill

special_waste_dropoff.label_tl: Espesyal na basura — may hiwalay na drop-off

price_provenance.note: These are indicative ranges, not observed Cainta counter prices. The UI must show last_verified_date alongside any price and visibly decay confidence as it ages (plan §10). Until verified_shops >= 25, present ranges as "typical range" and never as "what this shop pays".
